source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'IPv4 and IPv6' (PDF 15): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: IPv4 IP addressing ka purana version hai. Yeh 32-bit ke numeric (numbers wale) addresses istemal karta hai. IPv4 ke addresses ki tadaad limited (mehdood) hai. IPv6 naya version hai jis ke addresses 128-bit ke hain. IPv6 zyada address space (zyada addresses ki gunjaish) deta hai. Yeh aaj ke Internet ki zarooratein poori karta hai.

blocks.explanation: IPv4 ke 32-bit addresses mehdood hain aur kam par rahe the; IPv6 ke 128-bit addresses bohat zyada hain.

items: IPv4: purana, 32-bit, mehdood addresses. IPv6: naya, 128-bit, bohat zyada addresses.
